program:
app "Art supplies" pencil mint
table material name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?, kind pick Home|Work|Other, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(material, it.qty <= it.low)
short "materials running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each material where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(material, it.qty * it.price) faint
form material
remind "Check your materials" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Art supplies, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- material: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5; price: money, optional; kind: one of Home, Work, Other; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the material have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "materials running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each material where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the material for editing; a swipe removes the material, with undo:
    - text: the name of the material.
    - text: the kind of the material.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the material.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the material to the qty of the material minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the material.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the material to the qty of the material plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the material.
- a form to add a material.
Reminder "Check your materials" at 9:00 on Sat.
